forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / DISA STIG: eval with dynamic content is the primary command injection vector in Bash.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove eval. Refactor to call specific functions or use arrays for command construction: cmd=("prog" "arg1" "arg2") && "${cmd[@]}"

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / CIS Benchmark: Piping remote content directly to bash/sh enables remote code execution.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Download scripts to a temporary file, verify their integrity (SHA-256 checksum and/or GPG signature), then execute from the local file.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: Unquoted variable expansion in rm -rf can cause unintended file deletion or path injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Always quote variables in destructive commands: rm -rf "${safe_path}". Validate paths before deletion.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / CWE-134: printf with a user-controlled format string is a format string vulnerability.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use printf '%s' "$user_input" to treat user input as data, not as a format specifier.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: Sourcing a script path derived from a variable can execute attacker-controlled code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use absolute, hardcoded paths for sourced files. Never source files whose path is derived from user input.

forbidden_patterns.reason: DISA STIG / CIS Benchmark: World-writable permissions (777) violate the principle of least privilege.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use minimal required permissions. For scripts: 750. For config files: 640. Never grant world-write access.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in shell script.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded passwords. Load from environment variables or use a secrets manager vault CLI.

forbidden_patterns.reason: DISA STIG / NIST SC-8: Telnet transmits credentials in plaintext and must not be used.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace telnet with SSH (ssh/scp/sftp) for all remote connections.

forbidden_patterns.reason: DISA STIG / NIST SC-8: FTP transmits credentials and data in plaintext.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace FTP with SFTP, SCP, or HTTPS for secure file transfers.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: MD5 is cryptographically broken and not FIPS-compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace MD5 with SHA-256: openssl dgst -sha256 or sha256sum.

forbidden_patterns.reason: CIS Benchmark: Disabling error handling options (set -e, set -u) removes fail-safe protections.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Keep set -euo pipefail at the top of every script. Never disable error-handling options within scripts.
